fusions.name: Feint Flare
fusions.desc: Flicks a dazzling trick flare that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted], its aim thrown off, for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Jack-in-the-Box
fusions.desc: Tosses a sprung box at an enemy up to 5 tiles away; it bursts open and deals 30 damage, ignoring the target's armour.

fusions.name: Mirror Cabinet
fusions.desc: Folding mirrors hide you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Loaded Dice Gear
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
